_readme: The curated demo tenant, as data. Read by scripts/demo_curate.py:
pins: the seven watches the monitors surface is built around. An eighth,
pin_5adb19e075f6 ('Atlas Commercial - days in ar'), was minted by a review
battery and measures the same metric as pin_df42253af604 ('days in A/R by
payer') under a different spelling; it is absent from this list on purpose
and the command archives it. Archiving is soft - the tile's evaluated
history stays readable and its permalink does not 404.
sessions: empty on purpose. This demo is walked LIVE - the presenter types
the questions - so there is nothing to pre-stage and an empty rail is the
goal, which is what --clean-rail produces. Pre-staging a walk? Put the
session ids here and drop --clean-rail; the command will then keep exactly
This file is not a seed. Nothing here creates a watch; it names the ones
that must survive a curation pass, so the pass can be run again.
